summary: Verified MOD-only module enforcement on PUT /api/master-admin/organizations/{id}/features (backend) and code-reviewed the 4 associated frontend refinements. Backend pytest tests both pass. Frontend UI could not be exercised end-to-end because /api/auth/login hit HTTP 429 rate-limits mid-run, so drawer / Modules tab expansion could not be repeatedly re-opened via browser — code-level verification recorded instead.
action_items: None — all 6 review items appear correctly implemented at code + API level.
If further UI proof is needed, wait for /api/auth/login rate-limit window to clear (60s) between runs.
critical_code_review_comments: master_admin_orgs.update_org_features correctly forces enabled=False and business_enabled/leisure_enabled=False for CRM/Memberships/Marketing/Staffing/Reporting on any is_mod org or account_type in {mod_site, mod_branch, mod_org}, and rebuilds enabled_modules + portal_type via the derived list, so the persisted org state stays consistent.

FeatureControlPanel.js lines 91–208: isMod detection (is_mod OR account_type in mod_*), groupedFeatures filter drops memberships/marketing/crm groups for MOD, and the module matrix renders a locked tile with data-testid=module-{key}-mod-locked-{orgId} and 'Not available for MOD organisations' — matches spec.
CRMCompanies.js sections order (line 1252) exactly matches requested order: Overview, Contacts, Deals, Quotes, Tenders, Invoices, Equipment & Assets, Service & Engineers, Site Surveys, Activity.

PartsRequestsPage.js embedded branch (lines 488-493): title/subtitle header is only rendered in the non-embedded path; embedded mode shows just the New Request button on the left — matches Reactive Faults 'Log New Fault' alignment.
EquipmentInfoTab.js: data-testid=equipment-info-tab wrapper is retained; grep confirmed no 'Equipment Information Hub' h2 remains.

success_rate.frontend: code-level only — UI drawer test blocked by 429 rate-limit

seed_data_creation: None. Reused existing seeded MOD orgs (ZZ QA MOD ARMY, ZZ QA MOD RAF) and iso-demo-org for regression.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend enforcement is authoritatively verified. For UI verification of the MOD-locked tiles, click the pencil icon on org-card (org-edit-{id}) for the MOD org and then click the 'Modules' tab in the drawer — expect data-testid=module-crm-mod-locked-{orgId}, module-memberships-mod-locked-{orgId}, module-marketing-mod-locked-{orgId} to appear. Login endpoint has an aggressive rate limit (429 after ~4 rapid logins) — space out browser sessions or reuse the same page context.
